content.text: Digital creators face significant challenges when it comes to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-stock-photos-without-paypal-which-architecture-actually-9|COREMERCH guide to selling]] their products online, especially if they are in regions where platforms like PayPal and Stripe are unavailable. This often forces creators to rely on expensive solutions like Gumroad, which charges a hefty 10% fee on sales. In contrast, using Cloudflare R2 for digital product storage and delivery, combined with NOWPayments for crypto transactions, offers a streamlined, cost-effective solution that ensures you keep more of your earnings. This post will break down how to leverage Cloudflare R2 and the sovereign commerce [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-selling-ebooks-nigeria-without-paypal-2|The Real]]-behind-bitcoin-payments-digital-downloads-stripe-6|architecture]] to store and deliver your digital products efficiently and affordably.

That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Cloudflare digital

Cloudflare R2 is a storage solution designed for developers and creators who need a reliable way to store and deliver digital products. It allows you to host your files without incurring high costs typically associated with traditional cloud storage. By using R2, you eliminate dependence on platforms that charge substantial fees, like Gumroad, which takes 10% of every transaction. Instead, you can utilize a combination of Cloudflare R2 for storage and NOWPayments for processing crypto payments, which only charges a minimal 0.5% fee. This shift not only increases your profit margins but also provides you with full control over your digital assets.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of using Cloudflare R2 involves several components working seamlessly together. First, you upload your digital products—be it ebooks, templates, or courses—to Cloudflare R2, which offers low-latency access and high availability. When a customer makes a purchase, a backend logic layer, often implemented through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, retrieves the product from R2. Once payment is confirmed via NOWPayments, the system automatically delivers the product to the buyer, ensuring a smooth transaction process. This setup not only simplifies the delivery mechanism but also enhances the user experience by providing instant access to purchased content.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are either unavailable or prohibitively expensive. If you're selling ebooks, online courses, or digital assets like fonts and presets, this architecture empowers you to operate independently. By integrating R2 for file storage and NOWPayments for crypto transactions, you eliminate reliance on traditional platforms that charge high fees and impose restrictions. This approach allows you to focus on creating and selling your products without the headache of navigating complex payment processing systems, giving you the freedom to thrive.
Cloudflare R2 offers cost-effective storage without egregious egress fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The core components of this setup include Cloudflare R2 for storage, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for cryptocurrency payment processing. R2 serves as a cost-effective and efficient storage solution for your digital products, while Workers or Apps Script handle the automated delivery process. NOWPayments allows you to accept a wide range of cryptocurrencies without the burden of KYC (Know Your Customer) requirements or high transaction fees. Together, these elements create a robust infrastructure that ensures your business operates smoothly and profitably, allowing you to retain more of your earnings.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with deploying your digital product store using Cloudflare R2 and NOWPayments, follow these steps: First, sign up for a Cloudflare account and create a new R2 bucket to store your digital products. Next, set up Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle the backend logic for order processing and delivery. Then, integrate NOWPayments to facilitate crypto payment processing. Finally, upload your products to R2 and test the entire flow to ensure everything works seamlessly. For a comprehensive resource, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates to streamline your deployment process.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using a combination of Cloudflare R2 for storage and NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency payments. This setup allows you to retain more of your earnings by avoiding high fees associated with traditional payment platforms. With R2, you have total control over your product delivery process, ensuring a smooth transaction for your customers.
NOWPayments enables crypto transactions with minimal fees, keeping more revenue in your pocket.

If you're looking to sell digital products without relying on conventional payment platforms, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides everything you need to build and deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for comprehensive resources and templates.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up Cloudflare R2 for my digital products?

To set up Cloudflare R2, sign up for a Cloudflare account, create a new R2 bucket, and upload your digital products. Ensure you configure the appropriate permissions for public access. This will allow your customers to download their purchases directly after payment.
What payment methods can I accept with NOWPayments?

NOWPayments allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies for your digital products. This flexibility enables you to cater to a global audience while maintaining low transaction fees, typically around 0.5% per transaction.
Can I automate product delivery with this setup?

Yes, by using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you can automate the entire product delivery process. Once payment is confirmed, the system retrieves the product from R2 and delivers it to the customer automatically, providing a seamless experience.
What are the advantages of using Cloudflare R2 over traditional storage solutions?

Cloudflare R2 offers lower costs, high availability, and seamless integration with other services like NOWPayments. Unlike traditional storage solutions, R2 does not charge egress fees, which significantly reduces your overall operating costs.
How can I ensure that my digital products are secure?

To secure your digital products in Cloudflare R2, set the appropriate access controls on your buckets and restrict public access to only the necessary files. Additionally, use HTTPS to encrypt data in transit, ensuring a safe transaction process for your customers.
